admission.justification: Realized across models/concepts.py, validate/concepts.py and validate/jargon.py and proved by negative/positive unit and compiler tests; prevents literal raw $...$ and LaTeX control sequences from leaking verbatim into Vue <ConceptHover> props and static Page Glossary <dd> elements.

applicability: Plain-text Concept Card frontmatter attributes (term, aliases, inline_glimpse) and explicit {{term:slug|display}} display overrides validated across models/concepts.py, validate/concepts.py and validate/jargon.py (and invoked fail-closed by site/compiler.py).
conditions: find_plain_text_latex rejects $$, paired unescaped $...$ spans, \(, \), \[, \], and \command control sequences while allowing a lone currency $, escaped \$, and non-command backslashes.

_validate_plain_text_fields emits concept-plain-text-latex on card term, aliases and inline_glimpse; _parse_term_directive emits term-display-latex on explicit {{term:slug|display}} overrides across all zoom levels.
exclusions: Ordinary Level 1/2/3 Markdown body prose outside {{term:...|display}} and ConceptCard.where_analogy_breaks are outside this plain-text attribute predicate.
statement: Plain-text Concept Card attributes (term, aliases, inline_glimpse) and explicit {{term:slug|display}} overrides must fail closed on paired $...$, $$, \(...\), \[...\], or \command LaTeX tokens while permitting lone currency $ and escaped \$.
title: Fail-closed plain-text LaTeX gate for card attributes and term overrides
